role: Director, Division of Planning, Florida Department of Transportation
summary: David H. Scott, Director of the Division of Planning for the Florida Department of Transportation, reviewed the draft environmental impact statement on off-road vehicle use on public lands and found it consistent with his Department's programs. He expressed support for the position of the Secretary of the Interior as outlined in the document.
